verdict.rationale: Metronome has a per-endpoint API reference (e.g., create-a-contract, create-a-billable-metric) and a published OpenAPI spec. Its docs point users to Postman to 'visually explore the Metronome API without writing code.' That gives runnable exploration, but through an external tool rather than evidence of an in-docs interactive 'try it' console. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive API explorer with runnable examples, documented code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
